This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/ Physical Mode).
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for the State-Opposite Party.
3.

The present application has been filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. by the Petitioner seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. No.1110 of 2024, arising out of Info City P.S. Case No.287 of 2024 pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C.-II, Bhubaneswar, for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 420/406 of the I.P.C.
4.

entities.text: Info City P.S. Case No.287 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It is stated by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that as per F.I.R. allegation, the Petitioner had taken away a sum of Rs.3,40,190/- by misusing the Petro Card which was issuing in favour of the employees by the employer.
He further contended that in the meantime the Petitioner has already repaid a sum of Rs.2,98,000/-.
He further submitted the Petitioner is having only one criminal antecedent and he belongs to the locality, therefore, there is no chance of his absconding.

5. Taking into consideration the aforesaid fact, this Court although is not inclined to grant pre-arrest bail to the Petitioner, however, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders before the Court in seisin over the matter within a period of three weeks from today and move an application Sameer Ranjan Panda vs State Of Odisha .....

1 for bail, the Court in seisin over the matter shall release him on bail in connection with the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
6. The release of the Petitioner shall be subject to the verification of the fact that the Petitioner has in fact returned a sum of Rs.2,98,000/- in the meantime.
Necessary documents be furnished before the court below for verification of such fact.
7. Accordingly, the ABLAPL is disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( Aditya Kumar Mohapatra) Judge Debasis Sameer Ranjan Panda vs State Of Odisha .....
